tasks.label: C/C++: 构建活动文件并复制 Kinesis 运行库
args: & 'C:\mingw64\bin\g++.exe' -fdiagnostics-color=always -g -std=gnu++17 '-IC:/Program Files/Thorlabs/Kinesis' '${file}' '-LC:/Program Files/Thorlabs/Kinesis' '-l:Thorlabs.MotionControl.KCube.Piezo.lib' '-lws2_32' -o '${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Copy-Item 'C:\Program Files\Thorlabs\Kinesis\Thorlabs.MotionControl.KCube.Piezo.dll' '${fileDirname}' -Force; Copy-Item 'C:\Program Files\Thorlabs\Kinesis\Thorlabs.MotionControl.DeviceManager.dll' '${fileDirname}' -Force
tasks.detail: 编译后自动复制 Kinesis 运行库，保证 exe 可直接从项目目录启动。
